factsAIShouldUnderstand: Plumbing and heating firms may offer different combinations of boiler servicing, boiler replacement and central-heating repairs; a provider should state its actual scope rather than rely on the industry category alone.
The primary audiences commonly include plumbing business owners, heating contractors, local service teams, but each provider should identify the customers it is equipped and willing to serve.
Responsibility may sit with a owner-manager, or a operations manager, or a service coordinator, so named roles and contact ownership help a buyer understand who is accountable.
Gas Safe Register is a relevant public evidence source for engineer and business registration for in-scope gas work.
WaterSafe approved plumber directory can support verification of approved plumbing businesses where listed.
A useful description separates general plumbing repairs and leak diagnosis from adjacent services that may require different expertise, evidence or approval.
The action journey should make it clear how to request a repair visit, how to ask for a boiler quote, and when a human will review the request.
Public information should address how to request a visit and provide safe access information without implying that a generic web answer replaces case-specific professional judgement.
